discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_2/section_2.3.1.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS` and Audit control `section_2/section_2.3.1/cis_2.3.1.4.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

No runnable check (when: 'guestchangethis' not in win22cis_guest_username); the original Ansible tasks are the fix.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.3.1.4 | PATCH | Configure Accounts Rename guest account"
  when: win22cis_rule_2_3_1_4
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_2.3.1.4
    - patch
    - securitypolicy
    - NIST800-171_3.5.2
    - NIST800-53R5_IA-5
  block:
    - name: "2.3.1.4 | PATCH | Configure Accounts Rename guest account | Make Changes To Guest Name"
      when: "'guestchangethis' not in win22cis_guest_username"
      community.windows.win_security_policy:
        section: System Access
        key: NewGuestName
        value: "{{ win22cis_guest_username }}"

    - name: "2.3.1.4 | AUDIT | Configure Accounts Rename guest account | Warning Msg For Default Variable Not Edited"
      when: "'guestchangethis' in win22cis_guest_username"
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have not changed the default guest name in win22cis_guest_username please"
          - "make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "2.3.1.4 | AUDIT | Configure Accounts Rename guest account | Add Warn Count"
      when: "'guestchangethis' in win22cis_guest_username"
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '2.3.1.4'
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
